dsl.source:
%% ofk 1
sequence
title: TokenBurnTrack — Hourly Ingest
autonumber
participant Scheduler
participant Collector
participant Adapter
participant Logs [db]
participant Pricing
participant SQLite [db]
participant UI [browser]
Scheduler -> Collector : tick (hourly :00 / startup / manual)
Collector -> Collector : try collector.lock (busy → skip run)
Collector -> SQLite : sync bundled prices; recompute added/corrected rows
Collector -> SQLite : insert ingest_run
loop each enabled harness (one thread per adapter) {
  Collector -> Adapter : discover(roots)
  Adapter -> Logs : list sources (log files / harness DB)
  Adapter --> Collector : sources (oldest mtime first)
  loop every source, every run {
    Collector -> SQLite : load cursor
    Collector -> Adapter : read(src, cursor)
    Adapter -> Logs : read past cursor (byte offset / row watermark)
    Adapter --> Collector : sessions + events + messages + next_cursor (unchanged → no tx)
    Collector -> Collector : link parent / resumed session; rebase running totals; apply privacy level
    Collector -> Pricing : price(events)
    Pricing --> Collector : cost_micros + price_id per event
    Collector -> SQLite : BEGIN; upsert sessions; insert events + messages ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; update hourly_usage + session totals; save cursor; COMMIT
  }
}
Collector -> SQLite : mark missing sources; finish ingest_run (stats, warnings, errors)
Collector -> Collector : release lock
Collector ->> UI : IngestFinished
UI -> SQLite : re-query visible pages

%% ofk 1
architecture right
title: TokenBurnTrack — System Architecture
appearance: pastel

group "Harness logs (local disk)" [gray] {
  cc = Claude Code [doc, orange, rank: 0, desc: "~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl · incl. subagents/"]
  codex = Codex CLI [doc, teal, rank: 0, desc: ~/.codex/sessions/*.jsonl]
  gemini = Gemini CLI [doc, blue, rank: 0, desc: ~/.gemini/tmp/…]
  opencode = OpenCode [cylinder, violet, rank: 0, desc: "~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db"]
  generic = Generic JSONL [doc, gray, rank: 0, desc: user-mapped fields]
}

group "tbt-adapters" [orange] {
  registry = Adapter Registry [component, rank: 1, desc: "HarnessAdapter trait · discover() · read()"]
}

group "Runners" [teal] {
  daemon = tbt-daemon [component, rank: 1, desc: "systemd/launchd/Task Scheduler · tbt-daemon install"]
  app = tbt-app GPUI [component, rank: 1, desc: "startup · hourly · Sync now · optional watcher"]
}

group "External price source (optional)" [gray] {
  litellm = LiteLLM price list [cloud, rank: 2, desc: "model_prices_and_context_window.json · fetched on click"]
}

group "tbt-collector" [blue] {
  sched = Scheduler [hexagon, rank: 2, desc: "hourly :00 · startup · manual · collector.lock"]
  pipe = Ingest Pipeline [rounded, rank: 3, desc: "discover → read → price → tx"]
  cursor = Cursors & Dedup [rounded, rank: 4, desc: "byte offset / row watermark · UNIQUE dedup_key"]
}

group "tbt-pricing" [green] {
  prices = Price Catalog [doc, rank: 3, desc: "bundled / imported / user"]
  pricer = Cost Engine [rounded, rank: 4, desc: "tokens × versioned price"]
}

group "tbt-store" [violet] {
  db = SQLite WAL [cylinder, rank: 5, desc: "sessions · usage_event · hourly_usage"]
}

group "GPUI UI" [pink] {
  dash = Dashboard [browser, rank: 6, desc: "KPIs · hourly burn · heatmap"]
  sess = Sessions [browser, rank: 6, desc: "table + session detail"]
  models = Models & Projects [browser, rank: 6]
  harn = Harnesses [browser, rank: 6, desc: "enable · roots · warnings · runs"]
  settings = Settings [browser, rank: 6, desc: "prices · LiteLLM import · privacy · export"]
}

cc -> registry
codex -> registry
gemini -> registry
opencode -> registry
generic -> registry
daemon -> sched : runs
app -> sched : runs
sched -> pipe : tick
registry -> pipe : sessions + events
pipe -> cursor
litellm --> prices : "import → new row, effective_from = now"
prices -> pricer
pipe -> pricer : price
pricer -> db : cost_micros
cursor -> db : tx per source
db -> dash
db -> sess
db -> models
db -> harn
db -> settings
